visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hands are visible in a bright, modern kitchen. One hand pours oil from a slim blue bottle into a black cast-iron pan resting on an induction cooktop. (2) Raw chicken thighs are placed skin-side down into the hot oil; a wooden spatula is used to firmly press the meat against the pan surface to ensure even browning. (3) The cooked chicken, now with a crispy golden-brown skin, is transferred to a white ceramic tray; a metal fork is used to scrape the skin, demonstrating its crispness. (4) Sliced white onions and green leek segments are added to the same pan and stirred with a spatula until translucent. (5) Chopped white cabbage stalks are added to the onions; salt and pepper are freshly ground over the vegetables from a transparent grinder. (6) A large, overflowing pile of fresh green cabbage leaves is stacked on top of the stalks, filling the pot to the brim. (7) A light blue enamel lid with the 'Le Creuset' logo is placed on the pot. (8) The lid is removed to reveal the wilted cabbage; the fried chicken pieces, whole garlic cloves, and ginger slices are added back into the mixture. (9) Soaked glass noodles are added to the steaming pot and stirred in. (10) The host, a woman with short dark hair wearing a white apron and a black oven mitt, opens the lid with a smile, revealing the completed dish. (11) The host serves the dish into a small white bowl and eats the noodles and chicken with chopsticks, showing an expression of extreme satisfaction and joy.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. (2) [Subtitle]: 先熱鍋3分鐘，倒入油(10ml) 潤鍋一下. (3) [Subtitle]: 接著把雞腿排放進來煎. (4) [Subtitle]: 暫時不要去動它 讓它煎出表面的焦香. (5) [Subtitle]: 壓一下雞肉，可以更快煎出焦香的外皮. (6) [Subtitle]: 確認一下煎的狀況 嗯~~可以再煎一下~. (7) [Subtitle]: 再壓一壓. (8) [Subtitle]: 好囉~可以起鍋了!. (9) [Subtitle]: 分切成大塊狀備用. (10) [Subtitle]: 聽聽這脆皮的聲音~ ❤️. (11) [Subtitle]: 接著，放入洋蔥絲、蒜白. (12) [Subtitle]: 先炒出香味. (13) [Subtitle]: 聞到洋蔥的香味後... (14) [Subtitle]: 放入白菜梗. (15) [Subtitle]: 翻炒均勻. (16) [Subtitle]: 先把白菜梗炒軟. (17) [Subtitle]: 一點鹽、胡椒調味. (18) [Subtitle]: 白菜要炒到像這樣 有點透的感覺~. (19) [Subtitle]: 白菜軟化，開始出水~. (20) [Subtitle]: 這時候就可以把白菜 都放進來了. (21) [Subtitle]: 白菜的份量是一整顆. (22) [Subtitle]: 不要擔心，努力的疊上來. (23) [Subtitle]: 像這樣放的滿滿的. (24) [Subtitle]: 先蓋上鍋蓋 中小火煮5分鐘!. (25) [Subtitle]: 好囉~開蓋!. (26) [Subtitle]: 這時候的白菜已經軟化了 會比較好翻炒. (27) [Subtitle]: 我都沒有加一滴水喔! 已經出這麼多水了~. (28) [Subtitle]: 再一點鹽、胡椒調味. (29) [Subtitle]: 放一些拍裂的蒜頭、薑片 翻拌一下. (30) [Subtitle]: 把剛剛的雞腿肉切塊好 放進來... (31) [Subtitle]: 拌一下~. (32) [Subtitle]: 剛剛的雞腿排沒有熟沒關係. (33) [Subtitle]: 現在再來慢慢的燉. (34) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後轉中小火 蓋上鍋蓋，燉煮15分鐘. (35) [Subtitle]: 好囉~開蓋!. (36) [Subtitle]: 這時候再放入泡軟的冬粉. (37) [Subtitle]: 拌一拌. (38) [Subtitle]: 蓋上鍋蓋 繼續再煮10分鐘. (39) [Subtitle]: 好囉~~ ❤️❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 香噴噴的味道~ ❤️❤️. (41) [Subtitle]: 拌一下 確認冬粉的熟度 ❤️❤️. (42) [Subtitle]: 吸飽湯汁的冬粉，超好吃~ ❤️❤️. (43) [Subtitle]: 像這樣~超級簡單 又好吃的『無水白菜雞』 就完成啦~ ❤️. (44) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉~ ❤️. (45) [Subtitle]: 嗯~雞肉好嫩 ❤️. (46) [Subtitle]: 好好吃喔~ ❤️. (47) [Subtitle]: 最喜歡這樣的白菜 軟軟的，可以吃很多~ ❤️. (48) [Subtitle]: 太簡單、太好吃了 大家趕快動手做起來! ❤️. (49) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Soft liquid pouring sound is heard as oil is added to the pan. Cheerful, upbeat acoustic pop background music starts, featuring a rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming pattern and bright piano melodies. (2) A sharp, loud percussive thud as chicken pieces are placed in the pan, followed immediately by an intense, continuous wide-spectrum sizzling sound. (3) Rhythmic metallic scraping and clicking sounds occur as a fork tests the crispy texture of the chicken skin. (4) Frequent mechanical grinding noises from a pepper mill are heard over the persistent sizzle of sautéing vegetables. (5) A series of hollow clicks follow as the heavy pot lid is placed and removed. (6) The female host's voice enters in the final third of the audio; she has a high-pitched, friendly, and enthusiastic tone with clear broadcasting articulation. (7) Distinct slurping and chewing sounds (crunching on cabbage and chicken) are emphasized during the tasting segment, accompanied by high-arousal vocal expressions of delight like 'Mmm'.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Ingredients Preparation -> Step-by-Step Cooking Process -> Final Dish Reveal -> Tasting and Review -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a step-by-step tutorial on how to cook a 'Waterless Cabbage Chicken' dish. The video emphasizes the simplicity of the recipe and the deliciousness of the results, aiming to inspire viewers to replicate the meal at home while subtly showcasing the efficiency of high-quality cookware.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: A 'Le Creuset' branded pot is prominently used throughout the cooking process, with the logo clearly visible on the lid. The video serves as a functional demonstration of the product's performance in a 'waterless' cooking scenario.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-arousal sensory cues (ASMR-style scraping sounds, sizzling, and slurping) to enhance the perceived appetite appeal.
